title: Spielberg's EA game 'LMNO' about a woman with alien empathy powers

tellings.quote: >> The game was codenamed LM O, and it was about a woman who is human but has alien capabilities running around using the power of empathy uh to disarm people because the government is chasing her.

plain: A writer named Brent Friedman says that around 2004 he worked at Electronic Arts, a big video game company in Los Angeles, on a game with the famous film director Steven Spielberg. Friedman says the game was code-named LMNO and was about a woman who is human but has alien abilities, using the power of empathy to disarm people while the government chases her. He tells it on a podcast about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, as a sign of how long Spielberg has been drawn to these themes.
